# artifactkeeper_project (Data Source)

Looks up an existing project by its key, resolving the UUID (`id`) you pass to `repository.project_id` and project memberships.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing project by key to resolve its id for repository.project_id.
data "artifactkeeper_project" "platform" {
  key = "platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Project key to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) Resolved project UUID.
- `name` (String)
- `quota_bytes` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)
